profile.name: 是德科技 MXRxx4A 四通道示波器
profile.description: MXRxx4A 是一类台式四通道数字示波器，用于采集、显示和分析电子信号波形。它适合实验室中的电路调试、时序分析、信号完整性检查以及通用电子测量。
profile.description_en: The MXRxx4A is a benchtop 4-channel digital oscilloscope used to capture, display, and analyze electrical waveforms. It is suited for laboratory tasks such as circuit debugging, timing analysis, signal integrity checks, and general electronic measurements.
